about: 蓝白 · 第 7b 幕 河伯宫殿布局（圣经 v2.1 §6·7b；唯一的数据源）。坐标 = 宫殿系（见 frame）。由 Palace/Source/palace_layout.py 生成

frame.origin: x = bus path, y = terrace top, z = bus origin at F5 (644.96)
frame.axes: Unity: x right (seen from the bus), y up, z = bus heading
frame.placement: R_Palace.localPosition = -busPos(t) (relative to the bus origin; bus at the world origin)

terrace.note: the lip face (x = edge_x, y lip_bottom..0) is solid rock with seaweed; BELOW the lip the terrace has NO underside (dream decision, README): from below, the palace lamps read as a constellation overhead (F7p); the buildings are veiled by fog from below (global _Udon_PalaceVeil)

under_bus_light.follows: nearest avenue pair (by z), from below the floor

specks.note: far lights of the drowned city beyond the fog: points 140-650 m away on the terrace (left and ahead), fog-free with own attenuation (_FogMode 2, _Atten 0.004); the same mesh hangs in the act-8 ceiling (Sea README §4)
